sections.heading: 1. Foot-friendly lacing
lines: ① Unlace and re-tie with even, snug tension.
② Skip the eyelets over the sore spot.
③ Use the top loop (heel lock) for heel hold.
④ Smooth the tongue so it lies flat.

caption:
Toto ties his laces extra tight before every run, and afterwards the top of his foot throbs.

Tendons and nerves sit just under the skin on top of the foot, so laces pulled too tight can keep pressing on them. Re-tying with even tension, skipping the eyelets over the sore spot and using the top loop to hold the heel can often help.

A sore spot on the bone, swelling, or numbness that lingers is worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 👟
